mission: one researcher's working craft to the people who will work with it next: [who: a new lab, a group, students]. A year of their work with an AI agent was mined into findings files.
standard: do not hand-wave, do not fixate on a specific use case

data-figures.scope: Publication data panels in the author's house style: benchmark heatmaps, ablation bars, scaling curves.
data-figures.must: A style module that imports and renders; the chart forms used and retired, each with its reason; the visual QC loop.
data-figures.notes: Render two demo panels from synthetic numbers and look at the PNG.

ml-baselines.scope: Baselines and budgets for benchmark tables.
ml-baselines.must: Equal budgets, frozen settings before the test split, the audit before the table.
ml-baselines.notes: Integrity guard: M1 section 10 records a request to drop unfavorable tables. Encode only: every table is reported, ties and losses included.
